description: This file defines the GrainTypeSharedContext class, which encapsulates shared functionality and state for all instances of a specific grain type in Orleans. It manages components, configuration options, placement strategies, and lifecycle events related to grain activation.

classes.name: GrainTypeSharedContext
classes.description: Provides shared functionality and state management for all instances of a specific grain type, including component management, configuration, placement strategy, and lifecycle event handling.

classes.name: IActivationLifecycleObserver
classes.description: Interface for observing grain activation lifecycle events, such as creation and destruction.

methods.name: GetCollectionAgeLimit
methods.description: Determines the duration after which idle grains are eligible for collection based on manifest properties, class-specific options, or default collection options.

methods.name: GetComponent
methods.description: Retrieves a registered component of a specified type, with special handling for PlacementStrategy and ILogger.

methods.name: SetComponent
methods.description: Registers or removes a component of a specified type.

methods.name: OnCreateActivation
methods.description: Handles logic to execute when a grain activation is created, such as incrementing grain counts.

methods.name: OnDestroyActivation
methods.description: Handles logic to execute when a grain activation is destroyed, such as decrementing grain counts.
